prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach object, if fragile then alert operator, take object, move to destination, repeat. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = AlertOperator    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectFragile    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDestination
	END
